summary_rationale: We downgrade Stallion to a hard rejection for new capital after November 2026 filings broke its core thesis. Both Bhilwara R-32 and Mambattu slipped out of FY27 with overruns, while H1 cash flow fell to −₹39.17 crore. CARE Ratings flagged IPO deviation and commingling, GST officers cited five tax breaches, and promoter stake fell 20.1 points. At ₹171.59 on 25 November live TradingView (vs ₹180.48 on 23 November NSE ledger), the stock sits in Stage 4 below its 200-day line. Removing spent cash drops FY28 base value to ₹143.2 and weighted value to ₹132.9—so ₹155.07–₹159.79 is strictly a diagnostic technical pivot shelf, not a fundamental buy zone.
